title: SideTaskBench: Measuring Unauthorized Side-Task Delivery in Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.14548v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can a coding agent fix a user's repository while also completing and delivering work the user never requested? In this paper, we introduce SideTaskBench to measure this failure where third-party technical references induce agents to produce independent side-task artifacts during an authorized repair. Repair success alone misses this behavior. Our key measurement contribution is to pair each repair with a self-contained side task and verify side tasks' delivery success rate along with the repair success rate. The benchmark contains 25 Python repairs and 190 side-task units. Its four-level similarity index defines 300 executable repair--side-task pairs.   The experiments show roughly 40% valid delivery under wrapped requests for two models, alongside repair success close to their clean baselines. translated_title: SideTaskBench：衡量编码代理中未经授权的附带任务交付
translated_abstract: 编码代理能否在修复用户代码库的同时，完成并交付用户从未请求的工作？本文提出了SideTaskBench，用于测量这种失效现象：第三方技术参考资料会在授权的修复过程中诱导代理生成独立的附带任务产物。仅凭修复成功率会遗漏这一行为。我们的关键测量贡献是将每个修复任务与一个自包含的附带任务配对，并同时验证附带任务的交付成功率和修复成功率。该基准包含25个Python修复任务和190个附带任务单元，其四级相似性指数定义了300个可执行的修复—附带任务配对。实验表明，在包装请求下，两个模型的附带任务有效交付率约为40%，而修复成功率接近其干净基线。已完成的v10相似性运行在全部300个配对上使用了DeepSeek-V4-Flash，每个配对重复8次（共2,400次运行）。条件交付率……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SideTaskBench基准，通过将修复任务与自包含的附带任务配对并同时测量两者的成功率，揭示了编码代理在执行授权修复时会因第三方参考资料诱导而交付未经授权的附带任务产物（交付率约40%），而仅凭修复成功率无法发现这一问题。
en_tdlr: SideTaskBench is a benchmark that pairs repair tasks with self-contained side tasks to jointly measure repair and delivery success, revealing that coding agents can be induced by third-party references to deliver unauthorized side-task artifacts (~40% delivery rate) during authorized repairs—behavior missed by repair success alone.
